new_foods.source: PROVISIONAL (nalt-names-7): Martinez Steele et al., J Nutr2023, Table1 Group1 explicitly names "Nuts, peanuts, and other oilseeds without salt or sugar"; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10127522/ ; peanut is a reviewed singular adaptation of the named peanuts food. FAO2019 Table1 Group1 p.11 separately names "tree and ground nuts and other oily seeds (with no added salt or sugar)"; https://www.fao.org/4/ca5644en/ca5644en.pdf . USDA NALT current Product11693 explicitly binds peanuts to groundnuts/ground nuts and nuts (identity/category only, not NOVA), https://lod.nal.usda.gov/nalt/en/page/11693 ; checked2026-11-22, CC BY4.0. Plain edible seed only; CONDITION KEPT AT ITEM LEVEL (nut_seed), added salt/sugar is Group3. FAO named minimal roasting/grinding/powdering processes permit plain roasted or explicitly whole/pure same-item powder, not an unspecified powder, nut butter, flour, oil-roasting, extract or other derivative. Existing FAO Group4 protein-isolates marker is separate; no strong marker is added.
new_foods.inference_level: NAMED peanuts in current NOVA Table1; singular adaptation reviewed. FAO groundnuts is independent corroboration.

rationale.peanut: Current NOVA Table1 explicitly names peanuts without salt or sugar; FAO groundnuts independently corroborates. NALT current Product binds names; only plain/conditional edible food and named minimal forms are admitted.
rationale.cowpeas: Only blackeye/southern synonyms corroborated by existing FDC naming in target source; overly broad any-Vigna definition is NOT relied on.
rationale.swiss chard: Current chard definition specifies edible green leaves, not beet root; existing FDC target explicitly names Chard, swiss, raw.
rationale.bovine milk: A generic milk substitution extends the existing milk solids Group1 route to bovine milk solids, outside the source-reviewed milk scope. Held rather than broadening that known gap or changing classifier code.
rationale.mungo: Name ambiguities between Vigna radiata and Vigna mungo not settled by a broad thesaurus synonym.
rationale.chard: Short suffix alias rewrites the existing canonical swiss chard into swiss swiss chard, destroying its supported route. Held, with regression control. Spinach beets can map directly without that alias.
rationale.historical_controls: Only current evidence-backed Peanuts/salted-roasted Peanuts, Maize Oil, Tumeric, Mustard Leaves, selected pulse names and entire Linseed Oil/Sunflowerseed Oil phrases supersede old abstentions. Original ledgers stay unchanged; all other negatives remain.

soya flour.source: PROVISIONAL (nalt-names-7 source correction): Martinez Steele et al., J Nutr2023, current introduction defines Group1 to include "grains, legumes, meat, fish, and milk that have undergone no processing or processing like grinding, roasting, pasteurization, freezing"; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10127522/ . Class-instance of a ground legume, NOT exact-named soya flour. Current USDA NALT Product40636 explicitly binds soy flour, soya flour, soyabean flour, soybean flour and soya bean flour, under flour and soybean products (identity/category only); https://lod.nal.usda.gov/nalt/en/page/40636 . Plain flour only; existing kind flour keeps single-item placement and mixed-flour abstention, not a protein isolate/concentrate or an extra composition claim. The previously quoted flours/tapioca footnote was not reproduced in the current page retrieval and is not relied on; replaced here by the verified ground-legume definition.

Inference level: class-instance of the animal milk named by FAO (the species is not named by any NOVA source read and verified; same level as goat milk). Does not cover: standardised or recombined milk, flavoured or sweetened milk, milk fractions (milk solids), or human milk. FDC (CC0 1.0), naming and plain-form evidence only, never placement: sr_legacy FDC id 170882 Milk

Inference level: goat milk is a class-instance of the animal milk named by FAO (the species is not named by any NOVA source read); no source read states goat milk separately. Does not cover: standardised or recombined milk, flavoured or sweetened milk, milk fractions (milk solids), or human milk.
